body: Thomas Murphy has been practicing law for more than 40 years and has been in his current location in downtown North Augusta since 2000. He served with the FBI before practicing law, and has been the City Judge for North Augusta since 1983.
We are a law firm that will make a hospital visit or a house call if you are unable to come to us.
